ProTable

PreviousNext

Feature-rich data table with search, filtering, reset, sorting, density toggle, column visibility, and drag-to-sort — powered by TanStack Table.

Installation#

Usage#

header is reserved for title and description content. Search, filters, and actions belong in the toolbar area. Use toolbar for business-specific controls, custom action buttons, or a composed group that manages its own alignment.

Examples#

Pinned Columns and Sticky Header#

Use meta.pinned on column definitions to keep important columns visible during horizontal scroll. Users can also pin or unpin columns from the column settings menu. System columns (select, drag, actions, operation) are pinned by default, use w-8 by default, and are hidden from column settings; columns with enableHiding: false are also omitted from column settings. The table header is sticky by default; set table={{ stickyHeader: false }} to disable it.

Filtering with Reset#

Add meta.search or meta.filter to columns — ProTable automatically renders the toolbar search input and Select filter controls, maps value → label in cells, and shows a Reset button whenever any filter is active.

  • Default filter behavior is single-select.
  • Set meta.filter.multiple: true for multi-select filtering.

meta.search writes to the same column filter state as the rest of the toolbar. Search columns use @tanstack/match-sorter-utils by default for fuzzy matching and rank-aware sorting in client-side tables. If you do not want to put search config in column meta, pass toolbarSearch={{ columnId: "name", placeholder: "Search name..." }} instead; the target column gets the same default fuzzy behavior.

When request is provided, ProTable switches to manual filtering and sorting. Fuzzy matching is not run on the client; search/sort state is passed through to your request handler.

Internally ProTable dispatches from props: local data uses the client-side implementation, while request uses the server-side implementation. No extra prop is required.

Filtering, searching, and sorting reset pagination to the first page automatically.

Request Data#

request receives pagination, filters, and sorting. Return { data, total }; you do not need to also pass pagination.total.

When a column has enableSorting: true, clicking the header updates TanStack sorting state. With useProTableUrlState, it also syncs to sort / order URL params by default.

Bulk Actions#

Configure bottom-floating bulk actions when rows are selected. The floating toolbar supports keyboard navigation and Escape clears the selection.

Drag-to-Sort#

Enable row drag-to-sort with the dragSort object. Use rowKey to specify the unique identifier field and onDragSortEnd to receive the reordered data.

Drag sorting reorders the backing data array by the currently rendered rows. When the table is filtered or paginated, the dragged row moves relative to the visible target row in the original data array.

API Reference#

ProTable#

PropTypeDefaultDescription
columnsColumnDef<T>[]—TanStack Table column definitions.
dataT[][]Table data array for local/client data.
request(state) => Promise<{ data, total? }>—Server request function. Return { data, total }; total feeds pagination automatically.
initialStatePartial<ProTableState>—Initial pagination, sorting, and column filters. Useful for URL-derived initial state.
onChange(state) => void—Called when pagination, sorting, or filters change. Useful for URL sync or manually loading data.
headerReactNode | (context) => ReactNode—Title/description area rendered above the toolbar. Do not put search, filters, or actions here.
toolbarfalse | ReactNode | (context) => ReactNodeenabledCustom toolbar content. Pass false to hide the whole toolbar.
toolbarSearchfalse | string | { columnId, placeholder? }from columns[].meta.searchExplicit toolbar search config. Writes to the target column filter.
onRefresh() => void—Optional refresh action.
toolbarDensitybooleantrueShow the density menu.
toolbarColumnsbooleantrueShow the column settings menu.
bulkToolbarfalse | ReactNode | (context) => ReactNode—Bulk toolbar actions shown when rows are selected.
paginationfalseenabledSet to false to hide pagination.
dragSortfalse | { rowKey?, onDragSortEnd? }—Drag sort config. Pass an object to enable row drag sorting.
loadingboolean | { rows? }falseShows a skeleton loading state. Object form configures skeleton rows.
layout'full' | 'auto''full'Full layout keeps pagination at the bottom with a spacer; the table itself still follows content height.
table{ stickyHeader?, pinning? }{ stickyHeader: true }Table behavior config. pinning can be controlled with { value, onChange(value) } or disabled with false.
classNamestring—Additional className for the outer container.

Column Meta#

MetaTypeDefaultDescription
searchboolean | { placeholder? }—Enables the toolbar search input from this column.
filter{ options, placeholder?, multiple?, onFilter? }—Auto-renders a Select filter and maps values to labels in cells.
filter.options{ label, value }[]—Options used by the auto-rendered Select filter.
filter.multiplebooleanfalseWhether the auto-rendered Select filter returns multiple selected values.
filter.onFilter(value, record) => booleanautoCustom matching function for advanced filter behavior.
pinned'left' | 'right'—Initial pinned position for the column.
align'left' | 'center' | 'right''left'Aligns header and body cell content.
classNamestring—Class applied to header, body, and skeleton cells. Use width utilities like w-32 or min-w-40 when needed. Columns without explicit size or width classes stay auto-sized.

useProTableUrlState#

Use URL search params as initial table state and sync later table state changes back to the URL — framework-agnostic via a search + navigate interface (compatible with TanStack Router, Next.js App Router, React Router, etc.).

Parameters:

OptionTypeDefaultDescription
searchRecord<string, unknown>—Current URL search params as a plain object.
navigateNavigateFn—Called with updated params to push to the router.
pagination.pageKeystring'page'URL key for current page.
pagination.pageSizeKeystring'pageSize'URL key for page size.
pagination.defaultPagenumber1Default page (omitted from URL).
pagination.defaultPageSizenumber10Default page size (omitted from URL).
sorting.sortKeystring'sort'URL key for sorting column id.
sorting.orderKeystring'order'URL key for sort order (asc / desc).
columnFiltersArray<ColumnFilterConfig>[]Column filter definitions with URL key mapping.

Returns:

KeyTypeDescription
initialStatePartial<ProTableState>Pass to <ProTable initialState={...} />.
onChange(state) => voidPass to <ProTable onChange={...} />.
